adh01.tr: There is no might nor power except with Allah.
adh01.fadl: “… from his heart, he will enter Paradise.” (Muslim, about the one who answers the mu'adhdhin)

adh02.tr: And I too bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner, and that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. I am pleased with Allah as Lord, with Muhammad as Messenger, and with Islam as religion.

adh03.tr: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent prayers upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim; You are indeed Praiseworthy, Glorious. O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim; You are indeed Praiseworthy, Glorious.
adh03.fadl: “When you hear the mu'adhdhin, say what he says, then send prayers upon me, for whoever sends one prayer upon me, Allah sends ten upon him.”

adh04.tr: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and of the prayer about to be established, grant Muhammad al-wasilah (a station in Paradise) and al-fadilah (a rank above all creation), and raise him to the praised station that You have promised him.
adh04.fadl: “Whoever says, upon hearing the call: … my intercession will be his on the Day of Resurrection.”

adh05.tr: Supplication made between the adhan and the iqamah is not rejected.

ram02.tr: The thirst has gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.

ram03.tr: O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy which encompasses all things to forgive me.
ram03.fadl: “The fasting person, when breaking the fast, has a supplication that is not rejected.”

aft01.fadl: “When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ finished his prayer, he would seek forgiveness three times and say: O Allah, You are as-Salam and from You is all peace; blessed are You, O Possessor of majesty and honour.”

aft02.tr: O Allah, You are as-Salam (the One free from every imperfection), and from You is all peace. Blessed are You, O Possessor of majesty and honour.

aft03.tr: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner; to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. O Allah, none can withhold what You give, and none can give what You withhold, and the wealth and status of the wealthy cannot benefit them against You.
aft03.fadl: “The Prophet ﷺ used to say after every obligatory prayer: …”

aft04.tr: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner; to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. There is no might nor power except with Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and we worship none but Him. His is all blessing, His is all bounty, and His is all excellent praise. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah; we make our religion sincerely His, even though the disbelievers dislike it.
aft04.fadl: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to proclaim Allah's oneness with these words after every prayer.”

aft05.tr: How perfect Allah is; all praise is for Allah; Allah is the Greatest.
aft05.fadl: “Whoever glorifies Allah after every prayer thirty-three times, praises Allah thirty-three times and declares His greatness thirty-three times – that is ninety-nine – and completes the hundred by saying: ‘None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner; to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent’, his sins will be forgiven even if they are like the foam of the sea.”

aft06.tr: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and all praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.

aft07.fadl: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded me to recite the Mu'awwidhat after every prayer.”

aft08.fadl: “Whoever recites Ayat al-Kursi after every obligatory prayer, nothing prevents him from entering Paradise except death.”

aft09.tr: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner; to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise; He gives life and causes death, and He is over all things omnipotent.
aft09.fadl: “Whoever says after the Fajr prayer, while still sitting as he was and before speaking: … ten times, ten good deeds are recorded for him, ten bad deeds are erased, he is raised ten degrees, he is protected that whole day from every harm and guarded from Satan.”

aft10.tr: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and deeds that are accepted.
aft10.fadl: “The Prophet ﷺ used to say, after praying Fajr, upon giving the salam: …”

mor01.tr: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the accursed. Allah – there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
mor01.fadl: The jinn told Ubayy ibn Ka'b: “Whoever says it in the evening is protected from us until morning, and whoever says it in the morning is protected from us until evening.” When he told the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The wicked one has spoken the truth.”

mor02.fadl: “Say: Qul huwa Allahu ahad and the two Mu'awwidhat (al-Falaq and an-Nas) in the evening and in the morning, three times; they will suffice you against everything.”

mor03.tr: We have reached the morning, and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner; to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of what is in this day and the good of what follows it, and I take refuge in You from the evil of what is in this day and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I take refuge in You from laziness and the misery of old age. My Lord, I take refuge in You from punishment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.

mor04.tr: O Allah, by You we have reached the morning and by You we have reached the evening; by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.

mor05.tr: O Allah, You are my Lord; none has the right to be worshipped except You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I abide by Your covenant and promise as best I can. I take refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favour upon me, and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.
mor05.fadl: “The master of seeking forgiveness is … Whoever says it during the day with firm faith in it and dies that day before evening will be among the people of Paradise.”

mor06.src: Sunan Abi Dawud 5069 · Sunan Abi Dawud 5078
mor06.tr: O Allah, I have reached the morning, and I call on You, the bearers of Your Throne, Your angels and all of Your creation to witness that You are Allah; none has the right to be worshipped except You, alone, without partner, and that Muhammad is Your servant and Messenger.
mor06.fadl: “Whoever says in the morning or the evening: ‘O Allah, I have reached the morning, calling You to witness …’, Allah frees a quarter of him from the Fire; whoever says it twice, Allah frees half of him; whoever says it three times, Allah frees three quarters of him; and if he says it four times, Allah frees him from the Fire.”

mor07.tr: O Allah, whatever blessing I or any of Your creation have this morning is from You alone, without partner; so to You belongs all praise and to You all thanks.
mor07.fadl: “Whoever says it in the morning … has fulfilled the thanks due for his day.”

mor08.tr: O Allah, grant my body well-being. O Allah, grant my hearing well-being. O Allah, grant my sight well-being. None has the right to be worshipped except You. O Allah, I take refuge in You from disbelief and poverty, and I take refuge in You from the punishment of the grave. None has the right to be worshipped except You.
mor08.fadl: When his son asked him why he repeated it three times morning and evening, Abu Bakrah said: “I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ supplicate with these words, and I love to follow his Sunnah.”

mor09.src: Sunan Abi Dawud 5081 · 'Amal al-Yawm wal-Laylah (Ibn al-Sunni) 71
mor09.tr: Allah is sufficient for me; none has the right to be worshipped except Him. Upon Him I rely, and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.
mor09.fadl: “Whoever says, in the morning and in the evening, ‘Allah is sufficient for me … Lord of the Mighty Throne’ seven times, Allah will suffice him in whatever concerns him.”

mor10.src: Sunan Abi Dawud 5074 · Sunan Ibn Majah 3871
mor10.tr: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religion, my worldly affairs, my family and my wealth. O Allah, conceal my faults and calm my fears. O Allah, guard me from in front of me and behind me, from my right and my left, and from above me, and I seek refuge in Your greatness from being taken unawares from beneath me.
mor10.fadl: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ never left these supplications in the evening and in the morning.”

mor11.tr: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things, I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You. I take refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil of Satan and his snares (also narrated: his shirk), and from committing evil against myself or bringing it upon a Muslim.
mor11.fadl: “Say it in the morning, in the evening, and when you lie down to sleep.”

mor12.tr: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in the heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
mor12.fadl: “There is no servant who says in the morning of every day and the evening of every night: ‘In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing … can cause harm …’ three times, and then anything harms him.”

mor13.src: Sunan Abi Dawud 5072 · Sunan Ibn Majah 3870
mor13.tr: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad ﷺ as my Prophet.
mor13.fadl: “There is no Muslim – or person, or servant – who says in the evening and in the morning: ‘I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion and with Muhammad as my Prophet’, except that it becomes a right upon Allah to please him on the Day of Resurrection.”

mor14.tr: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer of all, by Your mercy I seek help: set right all my affairs for me, and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.
mor14.fadl: The Prophet ﷺ said to Fatimah (may Allah be pleased with her): “What prevents you from listening to what I advise you? That you say in the morning and in the evening: …”

mor15.tr: We have reached the morning, and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day: its opening, its victory, its light, its blessing and its guidance; and I take refuge in You from the evil of what is in it and the evil of what follows it.
mor15.fadl: “When one of you reaches the morning, let him say: ‘We have reached the morning and all sovereignty belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds …’ Then when he reaches the evening, let him say the same.”

mor16.tr: We have reached the morning upon the fitrah of Islam, upon the word of sincere devotion (La ilaha illallah), upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and upon the way of our father Ibrahim, who was upright, a Muslim, and was not of those who associate partners with Allah.

mor17.tr: How perfect Allah is, and I praise Him.
mor17.fadl: “Whoever says, in the morning and in the evening, ‘Subhan Allahi wa bihamdihi’ one hundred times, no one will come on the Day of Resurrection with anything better than what he brings, except someone who said the same or more.”

mor18.tr: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and all praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.
mor18.fadl: “Whoever says ‘None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner; to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent’ ten times is like one who has freed four souls from the descendants of Isma'il.”

mor19.tr: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and all praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.
mor19.fadl: “Whoever says ‘None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner; to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent’ one hundred times in a day, it will be for him equal to freeing ten slaves; one hundred good deeds will be recorded for him and one hundred bad deeds erased; it will be a protection for him from Satan that day until evening; and no one will bring anything better than what he brings, except someone who did more.”

mor20.tr: How perfect Allah is, and I praise Him, by the number of His creation, by His pleasure, by the weight of His Throne, and by the ink of His words.
mor20.fadl: “After leaving you I said four phrases, three times, which, if weighed against all you have said since this morning, would outweigh it.”

mor21.tr: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and deeds that are accepted.

mor22.tr: I seek Allah's forgiveness and I turn to Him in repentance.
mor22.fadl: “O people, repent to Allah, for I repent to Him one hundred times a day.”

mor23.tr: O Allah, send prayers and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.
mor23.fadl: “Whoever sends prayers upon me ten times in the morning and ten times in the evening, my intercession will reach him on the Day of Resurrection.”

eve19.tr: I seek Allah's forgiveness and I turn to Him in repentance.
eve19.fadl: “O people, repent to Allah, for I repent to Him one hundred times a day.”

eve20.tr: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
eve20.fadl: He ﷺ said to a man who had been stung by a scorpion: “Had you said in the evening, ‘I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created’, it would not have harmed you.”

eve21.tr: O Allah, send prayers and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.
eve21.fadl: “Whoever sends prayers upon me ten times in the morning and ten times in the evening, my intercession will reach him on the Day of Resurrection.”

tsb01.tr: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him.
tsb01.fadl: “Whoever says ‘Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him’ a hundred times in a day, his sins will be wiped away even if they are like the foam of the sea.”

tsb03.tr: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him; glory be to Allah the Magnificent.
tsb03.fadl: “Two words are light on the tongue, heavy on the Scale, and beloved to the Most Merciful: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him; glory be to Allah the Magnificent.”

tsb04.tr: Glory be to Allah, all praise is for Allah, none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and Allah is the Greatest.
tsb04.fadl: “That I say: Glory be to Allah, all praise is for Allah, none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and Allah is the Greatest — is more beloved to me than all that the sun rises upon.” And he ﷺ said: “The most beloved words to Allah are four: Glory be to Allah, all praise is for Allah, none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and Allah is the Greatest. It does not matter which of them you begin with.”

tsb06.tr: Glory be to Allah the Magnificent, and praise be to Him.
tsb06.fadl: “Whoever says ‘Glory be to Allah the Magnificent, and praise be to Him,’ a palm tree is planted for him in Paradise.”

tsb07.tr: There is no might and no power except with Allah.
tsb07.fadl: “O 'Abdullah ibn Qays, shall I not direct you to a treasure from the treasures of Paradise?” I said: Yes, O Messenger of Allah. He said: “Say: There is no might and no power except with Allah.”

tsb02.tr: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He is over all things competent.
tsb02.fadl: “Whoever says: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner; to Him belongs the dominion and all praise, and He is over all things competent — ten times, it is as if he freed four souls from the descendants of Isma'il.”

stg01.tr: I seek Allah's forgiveness and I turn to Him in repentance.
stg01.fadl: “By Allah, I seek Allah's forgiveness and turn to Him in repentance more than seventy times a day.”

stg03.tr: I seek the forgiveness of Allah the Mighty, besides whom none has the right to be worshipped except Him, the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting, and I turn to Him in repentance.
stg03.fadl: “Whoever says: I seek the forgiveness of Allah the Mighty, besides whom none has the right to be worshipped except Him, the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting, and I turn to Him in repentance — he will be forgiven even if he had fled from the battlefield.”

tsb14.tr: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent prayers upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim; indeed You are Praiseworthy, Glorious. O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim; indeed You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.
tsb14.fadl: They said: O Messenger of Allah, we have learned how to send greetings of peace upon you, so how do we send prayers upon you? He said: “Say: …”

tsb09.tr: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, grant me well-being and provide for me.
tsb09.fadl: When a man accepted Islam, the Prophet ﷺ would teach him the prayer, then instruct him to supplicate with these words. In another narration: “For these gather for you [the good of] your worldly life and your Hereafter.”

fri_kahf.tr: Whoever recites Surat al-Kahf on Friday, a light will shine for him between the two Fridays.

fri_salawat.tr: Among the best of your days is Friday… so send abundant blessings upon me on it, for your blessings are presented to me.

tsb16.tr: Whoever sends one prayer upon me, Allah sends ten prayers upon him for it.

tsb15.tr: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and upon his wives and his descendants, as You sent prayers upon the family of Ibrahim; and send blessings upon Muhammad and upon his wives and his descendants, as You sent blessings upon the family of Ibrahim; indeed You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.

tsb17.tr: Do not make my grave a place of festivity, and send prayers upon me, for your prayers reach me wherever you are.

tsb20.tr: There is no one who sends greetings of peace upon me except that Allah returns my soul to me so that I may return his greeting.

tsb19.tr: Allah has angels who roam the earth and convey to me the greetings of peace from my Ummah.

haj06.tr: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and all praise, and He is over all things competent.
haj06.fadl: “The best supplication is the supplication on the Day of ‘Arafah, and the best of what I and the prophets before me have said is: ‘None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner…’”

slp02.fadl: Satan told Abu Hurayrah: “When you go to your bed, recite Ayat al-Kursi … a guardian from Allah will remain over you and no devil will come near you until morning.” The Prophet ﷺ said: “He has told you the truth, though he is a great liar.”

slp03.fadl: “Whoever recites the last two verses of Surat al-Baqarah at night, they will suffice him.”

slp04.tr: In Your name, my Lord, I lay down my side, and by You I raise it. If You take my soul, then have mercy on it; and if You send it back, then protect it with that with which You protect Your righteous servants.
slp04.fadl: “When one of you goes to his bed, let him dust off his bed with the inner edge of his lower garment, for he does not know what has come onto it after him; then let him say: …”

slp05.tr: O Allah, You created my soul and You take it in death; to You belong its death and its life. If You keep it alive, then protect it, and if You cause it to die, then forgive it. O Allah, I ask You for well-being.

slp06.tr: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You resurrect Your servants.

slp07.tr: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

slp08.fadl: “Shall I not teach you something better than what you asked me for? When you lie down to sleep, say Allahu akbar thirty-four times, Subhan Allah thirty-three times and Alhamdulillah thirty-three times; that is better for you than a servant.”

slp11.tr: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Mighty Throne, our Lord and Lord of all things, Splitter of the seed and the date-stone, Revealer of the Torah, the Gospel and the Criterion (the Qur'an): I take refuge in You from the evil of everything whose forelock You hold. O Allah, You are the First, so there is nothing before You; You are the Last, so there is nothing after You; You are the Most High (al-Zahir), so there is nothing above You; and You are the Most Near (al-Batin), so there is nothing beyond You. Settle our debt for us and free us from poverty.

slp12.tr: All praise is for Allah, who fed us and gave us drink, who sufficed us and sheltered us; for how many are there who have none to suffice them and none to shelter them.

slp13.tr: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things, I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You. I take refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil of Satan and his shirk (his call to associate partners with Allah), and from committing evil against myself or bringing it upon a Muslim.
slp13.fadl: “Say it in the morning, in the evening, and when you lie down to sleep.”

slp14.tr: Recite Surat as-Sajdah (Alif Lam Mim. Tanzil…, chapter 32) and Surat al-Mulk (Tabarak alladhi biyadihi al-mulk, chapter 67).
slp14.fadl: “The Prophet ﷺ would not sleep until he had recited Alif Lam Mim Tanzil (as-Sajdah) and Tabarak alladhi biyadihi al-mulk (al-Mulk).”

slp15.tr: O Allah, I submit my soul to You, I entrust my affair to You, I turn my face to You, and I lean my back on You, in hope of You and in fear of You. There is no refuge and no escape from You except to You. I believe in Your Book which You have revealed and in Your Prophet whom You have sent.
slp15.fadl: “When you go to your bed, perform wudu as you do for prayer, then lie on your right side and say: … If you die that night, you will die upon the fitrah; and make these the last words you say.”

slp16.tr: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, the One, the Subduer, Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, the Almighty, the Oft-Forgiving.

stg04.tr: The closest that the Lord comes to His servant is in the last part of the night, so if you are able to be among those who remember Allah at that hour, then do so.

wak01.tr: All praise is for Allah, who gave us life after having caused us to die, and to Him is the resurrection.

wak02.tr: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner; to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. How perfect Allah is, all praise is for Allah, none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Allah is the Greatest, and there is no might nor power except with Allah, the Most High, the Most Great. My Lord, forgive me.
wak02.fadl: “Whoever wakes up at night and says: … and then says, ‘O Allah, forgive me’, or makes a supplication, he will be answered; and if he performs wudu and prays, his prayer will be accepted.”

wak03.tr: All praise is for Allah, who restored my body to health, returned my soul to me, and permitted me to remember Him.
wak03.fadl: “When he wakes up, let him say: ‘All praise is for Allah, who restored my body to health, returned my soul to me, and permitted me to remember Him.’”

ram07.tr: O Allah, You are Pardoning and You love to pardon, so pardon me.
ram07.fadl: She said: “O Messenger of Allah, if I know which night is Laylat al-Qadr, what should I say in it?” He said: “Say: …”
